thread:
elaine: @tom FYI - Anchorlytics on Dedicated pool ded-42 reporting a sudden spike of 429s + a handful of 401s after yesterday's campaign. Customer says reserved throughput should cover it. Can we triage? :rotating_light:

anchorlytics-prod: 23:04UTC we started seeing 429s. Request trace ids: r:0a3f... r:1b2e... Token meter spiked to ~5.6k TPS for ~90s then admission started rejecting. Billing dashboard shows burst allowance unchanged during the window (0 -> 0).

tom: Thanks. Do we have admission-controller logs and pool metrics for ded-42? Also need customer account ID and any recent config changes (quant, concurrency limits).

elaine: Account ID x-ank-009. No config changes on their side; they upgraded model version two days ago but have been stable until last night. Sending logs now.

mike: Pasted the admission log snippet below - looks like the controller marked requests as NO_HEADROOM even though pool utilization was ~70%:

```
[2025-08-12T23:04:15Z] pool=ded-42 admission_check id=0a3f status=DENIED reason=burst_allowance_exhausted headroom=0 reserved_tokens=4000 observed_tps=5600
[2025-08-12T23:04:16Z] pool=ded-42 autoscaler_state=idle target_gpu_util=0.65 current_gpu_util=0.68 pending_nodes=0
```

mike: Also saw autoscaler did not scale because target_utilization not breached; why did headroom calc return 0? Looks like a math path where prefix cache warmup memory shows as available and reduces effective headroom.

anchorlytics-prod: We also saw intermittent 401s for the same traces - unclear if that's downstream auth or our client retry pattern hitting admission token accounting oddities.

sophia: Oncall here - quick repro plan: 1) run a 3min ramp to 6k TPS against ded-42 with KV cache disabled, 2) tail admission logs and metrics (headroom, reserved_tokens, observed_tps), 3) check billing events stream for burst debit records. If we can reproduce we can confirm race between admission accounting and billing events.

elaine: Repro done in staging earlier and confirmed similar behavior when cache warmed mid-run — admission headroom drops unexpectedly. I captured a full trace and will upload.

mike: Hypothesis: admission controller uses an async refill callback for burst allowance that races with the per-request debit. If refill event delayed (billing ingestion lag), allowance shows zero and admissions deny despite capacity. Also autoscaler relies on GPU util only; short token spikes can blow headroom before scale kicks in.

billing-bot: Billing ingestion pipeline reported a 38s lag for account x-ank-009 around 23:04 UTC due to transient Kafka partition rebalancing. Burst debit events were delayed.

tom: That matches. So two failure modes converged: 1) billing/event lag -> displayed/current allowance out-of-sync with real-time accounting, 2) admission atomics/race -> rejections despite pool having spare GPU throughput.

elaine: Customer is asking for immediate mitigation and an RCA. Short-term: can we temporarily relax admission policy for ded-42 (increase emergency admission buffer) and backfill any burst credits billed incorrectly?

mike: I can push an emergency override: set admission.emergency_buffer_tokens=+2000 for ded-42 for 15 minutes, and enable a short-term policy to ignore billing lag up to 60s. Will need deploy-bot to roll the change to controller config.

deploy-bot: Rolling config change to admission-controller:d4 on pool ded-42. Change id cfg-2025-08-12-evict1. Will apply as hotpatch; expected ~12s window.

sophia: After override we should run targeted load test and confirm 429s stop and latency stays within SLO. Also validate autoscaler tuning — maybe add a TPS-aware trigger or reduce scale threshold for short blasts.

billing-bot: I'll schedule a backfill job to reconcile the delayed debit events for x-ank-009 and emit an account credit if we find they were wrongly blocked. ETA 3h for full reconciliation but I can push urgent patch for this account within 30m.

tom: Action items: 1) infra (mike) hotpatch admission buffer + add temporary ignore-lag window (done by deploy-bot). 2) oncall (sophia) run repro and validate. 3) billing (billing-bot) backfill credits + report. 4) eng (mike/tom) follow up RCA on race and plan durable fix (atomic accounting + TPS-aware autoscaling). 5) support (elaine) notify Anchorlytics and offer credit and postmortem timeline.

elaine: I'll open a P0 ticket to track and message the customer with the immediate mitigation and ETA. Thanks team :white_check_mark:

anchorlytics-prod: We're back to normal after the override. Appreciate fast response. Will await postmortem and credit confirmation.

mike: Preliminary root cause: burst allowance refill events delayed by billing ingestion lag + admission controller race on allowance==0 path. Fix plan: (A) make refill atomic with debit, (B) add short-term admission smoothing and TPS-based autoscale trigger, (C) monitoring: add a synthetic that exercises burst path and alerts on headroom mismatch.

tom: I'll own the RCA doc and coordinate timelines. Closing thread once billing confirms backfill.
